about: Hand-maintained corrections and additions to offers/custofinal.json (the scraped blog). An entry whose id exists there overrides the fields it lists; {"id": ..., "disable": true} removes it; {"add": true} adds a new offer (all fields required); an override or disable whose id is not in the scrape fails the tests. Every entry needs source and checkedAt, and the source host must be in sourceHosts (also for offers/nap-notes.json). Guide: docs/04-operator-offers.md.

offers.why: IONITY's own launch of direct sales in Portugal (20 Oct 2026) says walk-up from 0.63 €/kWh; the blog's 14 Oct post says 0.62.

offers.label: Electroverse - colaboradores Powerdot (50 %)
offers.why: Powerdot employees pay half of Electroverse's price at Powerdot chargers. Only the 150 kW band was seen (0.36 €/kWh + 0.30 € connection fee, exactly half of electroverse-rede-mobi-e's 0.72); the other bands are half of that row too, not seen. The employee discount itself has no public page: the 150 kW price is from a Powerdot employee's Electroverse app at HRZ-AMD-00054 (screenshot, 30 Oct 2026); the source is the blog row it halves.

Tesla prices every Supercharger on its own and by time of day (Mealhada in the Tesla app, 29 Oct 2026: 0.27 / 0.41 / 0.58 €/kWh without subscription); the blog's one price for the whole network is wrong at most sites and hours. The NAP's per-site price (offers/nap-notes.json) stands in.
